kitDescription: Tia is a Burst-I rocket-launcher Defender whose whole kit revolves around her cover. Whenever her cover's HP is restored — in practice each time she uses her burst, which restores cover HP on cast — she shaves 13 seconds off her own burst cooldown and grants the entire team (herself included) +32.11% attack damage for 10 seconds. Her burst puts a 10-second shield on herself (35.07% of her max HP) and a separate smaller shield on her four allies (10.21%, excluding herself), then re-opens Burst Stage 1 so a second Burst-I unit can also cast inside the same chain. After every five normal attacks she briefly raises her cover's max HP and taunts all enemies, and her burst additionally gives her lifesteal over 10 seconds. In a damage sim her offensive footprint is the team attack-damage buff plus the rotation effects of her cooldown reduction and stage re-entry; the shields, taunt, cover HP, and lifesteal are defensive.

RECON_ERROR by S5; its own blind-family override (S6) fails these two assertions identically.
R2 'the whole team loses damage when the heal is cut' — same root cause as R1 (driver skill2 is empty, so the NO_HEAL patch is a no-op). RECON_ERROR by S5.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found. All nine kit lines are FAITHFUL (6) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (3, all defensive channels with no v1 representation, carried verbatim). The one genuine modeling judgment — keying skill1 to burstCast instead of the engine's generic `recovery` trigger — was independently derived by three of the four agents (driver, S2b, S6) for the same reason (`recovery` over-fires on ally unit-HP heals, which are not Cover-HP recovery), and S5's contrary chained-heal reading is refuted intra-family: its own blind-family override fails S5's two discriminator assertions identically. The remaining S5 REDs are a null-vs-undefined test artifact and an over-tight byte-equality assertion that ignores legitimate rotation coupling through reenterStage + first-ready. The driver's reenterStage modeling is the SSOT-named mechanic with a frame-exact discriminating test (T6), and the 'missing primitive' the blind agents reported is a redaction artifact (types.ts:304 was stripped because its comment names Tia). The one real residual is fully documented with direction: passive environmental cover regen would proc skill1 between bursts (in-game effective CD ~20s vs the sim's 27s, plus higher buff uptime) — COLD, unmodelable without boss damage on cover, and near-nil in standard comps where B2/B3 40s cooldowns gate FB cadence. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: all four agents are same-family, so the burstCast-proxy convergence proves stability, not correctness — the one thing no artifact here can confirm is the real in-game cover-regen proc cadence behind the ~20s effective-CD claim; a single footage read of tia's inter-burst gap in a live fight would settle it and is the only measurement worth queuing.
